messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: GPU pool eu-west-1-gpu-pool at 100% utilization, queue length=3124. Multiple throttles observed; user-facing latencies > 10s and 429s returned for large batch jobs. Severity: high. Pager: @alex (oncall).

alex: I'm oncall, acking. pulling metrics now. anyone near eu-west oncall rotation?

maria: I can help, pinging infra console. seeing spikes in pod pending + node provisioning failures.

alex: copying logs — here's the autoscaler error I see:
```
autoscaler-controller: scale request +12 gpus -> failed (provider quota). reason=QuotaExceeded: requested 76 GPUs, quota=64 (account/project eu-west-1). status=403
custom-metric-adapter: eval_desired=0 (int division bug?)
```

alex: interesting — provider quota hitting us and autoscaler tries to request nodes but provider rejects. also HPA showing desiredReplicas=0 for some workersets despite queued work.

sanjeev: that HPA bit might be the metric adapter rounding bug we saw in canary. if desired is computed with integer division and small ratios go to 0, it won't scale. i reported a flaky metric adapter in staging last month.

maria: confirmed: custom metric 'queue_depth_per_gpu' returns floats but our adapter casts to int before scaling. for mid-late-night traffic spike, desired computed as 0 for some nodegroups.

alex: ok immediate plan: 1) emergency mitigation to free capacity 2) fallback routing to smaller model variants for heavy token requests 3) temporary rate-limits for batch tenants 4) file provider quota increase and manual node provisioning to dedicated pool. who can run node bootstrap?

eva: I can launch manual nodes into dedicated pool 'eu-west-1-dedicated-1' (we have reserved capacity). will start now — aiming +16 GPUs.

david: I'm enabling a temporary ingress-level rate limit for POST /v1/generate from orgs with monthly > $50k. applying rule in APIGW policy.

ben: i'll flip routing to 'redwood-medium-8q' for requests >2k tokens for non-enterprise keys. small change in router config, ready to apply.

alex: great. maria, can you toggle the HPA metric adapter to the temporary safe mode (use float ceil to compute desired) so HPAs can scale?

maria: on it. patching a hotfix to metric adapter now. running `kubectl rollout restart deploy/metric-adapter -n infra` after patch.

(Deploy-bot): deploy-bot: Started rollout: infra/metric-adapter @maria — rollout id: r-20240318-01.

maria: hotfix applied. HPA now showing desiredReplicas>0 for affected sets.

alex: eva, status on dedicated pool nodes?

eva: manual nodes provisioning via cloud console started. hitting one transient API error but provider accepted initial 8/16. currently booting.

alex: david, rate-limit applied?

david: yes, rate limits live. logs show immediate drop in heavy batch traffic from top 5 tenants. those tenants notified about throttling.

ben: router change deployed. heavy requests now served by redwood-medium-8q for non-enterprise keys. CPU/latency tradeoff looks ok.

alex: good. i'm going to start migrating non-critical batch jobs off the shared pool — evicting them to internal-dedicated.

ben: evictions queued, starting soft eviction (nice=+10) for batch jobs tagged non-prod.

sanjeev: provider ticket opened CP-8841 for quota increase to 120 GPUs, marked urgent. ETA unknown. I'm also escalating with partner rep.

alex: putting public-facing status note:
incident-bot: STATUS: We are experiencing degraded performance and intermittent throttling for batch workloads in eu-west-1. Mitigations: temporary rate limits for large batch tenants, routing heavy requests to smaller model variants, manual capacity provisioning. No data loss. We will post updates every 15m.

alex: timeline so far:
- T+0: incident-bot alert (queue >3k)
- T+5m: manual routing + rate limits + metric adapter hotfix applied
- T+12m: manual nodes started into dedicated pool (8/16 accepted)
- T+30m: queue drained below 500, throttles reduced

maria: i want to call out root causes probable chain: (1) autoscaler requested nodes but provider quota blocked scale up; (2) custom metric adapter integer-cast bug prevented HPA from scaling certain worker sets; (3) lack of automated fallback to dedicated/reserved pools.

alex: agreed. triage notes: customer impact: heavy batch jobs from ~7 tenants saw 429s and delayed runs (~30-60min). API interactive latency degraded for long-run requests but chat/low-token traffic mostly ok.

ben: we should add an automated policy: if queue>threshold and scale request failed for X seconds, automatically route new incoming large-token requests to fallback models.

david: also add a safety for provider quota failures: if provider returns QuotaExceeded, mark pool as "quota-blocked" and attempt immediate manual allocation to reserved pools.

alex: creating incident ticket INS-4291 and triage epic EPIC-1220. owners: alex (incident lead), maria (autoscaler/metric), sanjeev (cloud/quota), eva (capacity ops), ben (routing), david (rate-limit).

alex: action items off the top: 
- [ ] INS-4292: patch metric adapter to remove integer cast and add tests (owner: maria)
- [ ] INS-4293: implement autoscaler fallback to dedicated/reserved pool when provider quota hit (owner: sanjeev)
- [ ] INS-4294: add quota-failure detection and automated alerting + runbook (owner: david)
- [ ] INS-4295: implement routing policy for heavy-token fallbacks and test ramp (owner: ben)
- [ ] INS-4296: run tabletop with cloud provider rep to reduce quota turnaround (owner: eva)

maria: i've already opened PR with the hotfix; will follow with unit tests and an integration test for the adapter. PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3389

sanjeev: i'll start on autoscaler fallback design doc and circle back with acceptance criteria.

alex: monitoring update: queue now at 120, pending pods 4, active util 78%. No further throttles observed for 10m.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT RESOLVED: GPU pool eu-west-1 returned to normal operation; queue stabilized. Severity downgraded to informational. Root-cause: provider quota + metric adapter bug + missing fallback. Postmortem assigned: INS-4291, owners listed.

alex: thanks all for quick actions. we'll run a full postmortem and follow the action items. closing the incident thread but keeping INS-4291 open for postmortem writeup.

ben: noted, will add logs and routing diffs to the postmortem.

maria: will schedule a short retro with infra and runtime teams tomorrow.

sanjeev: assigning follow-ups in tasks board.

alex: final note: customer comms draft ready, will send consolidated update to support and success to notify affected tenants.

pagerduty: pagerduty: Alert cleared for incident 4291234567.

(End of thread)
